verdicts.reason: A gets the reading order wrong: the 'NEW FLAVOR' badge is oversized and jammed against the left edge, so it is louder than the headline. The body copy comes before the tiny SOLSTICE logo and the headline, and the CTA label 'Shop the Summer Line' is shrunk until it can't be read. B reads in a sensible order (badge, can, headline, copy, CTA) and its CTA is legible. B still needs fixing: 'Chase the / Light' wraps awkwardly at a 90px height, the SOLSTICE logo under the badge is tiny and low-contrast, and the body copy sits partly on a decorative circle.
